name: Empty state
purpose: Tell the user why a region is empty and, if there is a sensible next step, offer exactly one.
whenToUse: A list, table or board has no items yet (first use).
A search or filter returned nothing (no results).
A region could not load its data (error loading).
A task queue or inbox is cleared and the user is caught up.
whenNotToUse: Anything with an illustration, mascot or decorative icon. Use words.
More than one action. Choose the one most users want; put others elsewhere.
Multi-paragraph explanations of how the product works (P05).
Instead of a loading state. Do not show an empty state before the data has loaded.
Tables where a blank cell is correct. Leave the cell empty, do not fill it with a dash or the word None.
Hiding the region entirely would be clearer than describing that it is empty.
anatomy: One line statement, --text-2, maximum about 46 characters per line.
At most one action: primary (emerald) for first use, secondary for recovery (Clear search, Try again).
Left aligned to the surrounding content by default, optionally centred inside a card or panel.
No illustration, no heading plus subheading pair.

variants.description: No items exist. States that plainly and offers the creating action.
variants.useWhen: A new account or empty collection. Copy: No projects yet. Create one to get started.

variants.description: Items exist but none match. Names the query and offers to clear it.
variants.useWhen: Search or filter returns nothing. Copy: No projects match "atlas".

variants.description: The data could not be fetched. Says what failed and offers Try again.
variants.useWhen: Network or server failure for a region. Copy: Projects could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
Cleared inbox or queue. Copy: You are all caught up.

behavior: Copy differs by cause: first use, no results and error loading are never the same sentence.
The error variant uses role=alert only when it appears as a result of a user action; otherwise role=status or none.
Do not show the empty state while loading; show the loading state first (see preset.loading-state).
The action label is a verb plus object (Create project), never Get started.
Keep the region's height stable so the layout does not jump between loading, empty and filled.
accessibility: The statement is plain text in a paragraph; do not hide it in an image.
The action is a real button or link with a descriptive label.
Error variant announces with role=alert when triggered by a user action.
Text uses --text-2 on --s1 and --s2 surfaces, above 4.5:1.
